Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t “weaker” or stronger than men—they’re fruit, while men are people, so the comparison doesn’t really apply.

If you mean why black olives seem softer than green olives: black olives are generally fully ripe, which makes their flesh softer; green olives are picked earlier and tend to be firmer.
